description: A database-stored text analyzer configuration. System analyzers have IDs 1-999; user-defined analyzers start at 1000+.

id.description: The unique ID of this text analyzer.

name.description: Display name. Unique within the organization (or globally for system analyzers).

organizationId.description: The ID of the Organization this resource belongs to. Null for system analyzers.

isSystem.description: True if this is a system analyzer (read-only, IDs 1-999).

etag.description: Synapse employs an Optimistic Concurrency Control (OCC) scheme.

createdOn.description: The date this resource was created.

modifiedOn.description: The date this resource was last modified.
